Tata Trusts Begins Search for New Tata Sons Chairman After Chandrasekaran's Decision

Tata Trusts has initiated the process to select a successor for N Chandrasekaran as the chairman of Tata Sons. Chandrasekaran announced he would not seek another term when his current tenure ends on February 20, 2027. The Sir Dorabji Tata Trust is leading the selection process. Tata Motors stated that this change will not affect its investment plans. Meanwhile, Tata stocks experienced a significant selloff following the news, though some later rebounded.
